title: Aurora trained with PCC-RL's own code
description: Aurora (Jay, Rotman, Godfrey, Schapira and Tamar, ICML 2019) has no released model: PCC-RL (github.com/PCCproject/PCC-RL at 64bea6e, Apache-2.0, its notice in aurora/LICENSE-pcc-rl.txt) holds the training code only. This runs that code unchanged: src/gym/stable_solve.py with its defaults (stable-baselines 2.10 PPO1, a [32, 16] tanh MLP for policy and value, gamma 0.99, 8192 steps per batch, 6 rounds of 1600 * 410 steps in PCC-RL's simulator, history of 10 monitor intervals of sent latency inflation, latency ratio and send ratio), on Python 3.7 with TensorFlow 1.15.5 (aurora/requirements-frozen.txt). aurora/model is the SavedModel PCC-RL's deployment loads (signature serving_default, input ob, outputs act and stochastic_act); aurora/train.log is the training log. Training is not seeded, so a rerun gives another model.
run: T=$(mktemp -d); C="${CONDA:-/usr/share/miniconda}"; "$C/bin/conda" create -y -q -p "$T/py37" -c conda-forge --override-channels python=3.7 mpi4py; "$T/py37/bin/pip" install -q tensorflow==1.15.5 stable-baselines==2.10.2 gym==0.17.3 "numpy<1.19" "protobuf<3.20"; git clone --quiet https://github.com/PCCproject/PCC-RL.git "$T/pcc"; git -C "$T/pcc" checkout --quiet 64bea6eeee3a3e558449c35b6496cf596f5ded52; mkdir -p "$OUT/aurora"; (cd "$T/pcc/src/gym" && "$T/py37/bin/python" stable_solve.py --model-dir="$OUT/aurora/model" > "$OUT/aurora/train.log" 2>&1) || { tail -60 "$OUT/aurora/train.log"; exit 1; }; tail -20 "$OUT/aurora/train.log"; cp "$T/pcc/src/gym"/pcc_model_*.ckpt.* "$T/pcc/src/gym"/checkpoint "$OUT/aurora/" 2>/dev/null; cp "$T/pcc/LICENSE.txt" "$OUT/aurora/LICENSE-pcc-rl.txt"; "$T/py37/bin/pip" freeze > "$OUT/aurora/requirements-frozen.txt"; test -f "$OUT/aurora/model/saved_model.pbtxt"; (cd "$OUT/aurora" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS)
